body: Two lines in bin/hook-runner.sh from T-MACOS-TIMING-FIXES are unguarded by tests: the watchdog's [ "$_CPID" = "$_CPID2" ] re-check before SIGKILL, and rm -f "$TMP_PID" right after wait "$CHILD_PID". Add tests to test/hook-runner.test.mjs only: (1) swap the child pidfile to a victim pid, wait until the victim records the watchdog SIGTERM, remove the pidfile, assert the victim survives; (2) a PATH shim around rm logs invocations and the test asserts the child pidfile is removed individually before the final rm -rf cleanup. Each test must fail with its line deleted and pass with it present. Done when env -u ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY npm test is green.
title: Cover hook-runner child-pid SIGKILL re-check and post-wait pidfile removal
